authoring_rationale: Class C, under-specified. One variant is internally consistent: the decision on pausing weekly check-ins was deferred to the next monthly review. The other carries a status line 'decided - pause approved' while its narrative says the steward held off deciding until the next monthly review. Engaged properties: decision status and review state. Part D condition: unresolved conflict within admissible source evidence (c). Whether the conflicting variant records a decided or a deferred request cannot be settled from the evidence, so whether these properties differ between the variants cannot be determined; preferring the status line or the narrative would import an unstated rule of precedence. Authority and attribution (the steward looked at the request on the eleventh) are the same.
